This is the rematch of the game that was played on 17-09-2000 which [[The Viper Squad]] also won 2-0. It had to be replayed because [[Apollyon]] allowed [[The Viper Squad]] to add [[Acid]] to their roster by mistake. The problem was that [[Acid]] played with [[Clan MalFunction]] earlier in the season so he wasn't allowed to play with [[The Viper Squad]] at all. == External links == * [http://www.challenge-tv.com/index.php?mode=demos&event=2 Challenge-TV SD1 demos] {{Smackdown}} [[Category:Matchreports]]
